results.title: Ghana World Cup 2026 Group L Preview: Black Stars Face England, Croatia and Panama Without Kudus - Nigerian Matchday
highlights:
Stars preview and betting guide.
[...]
Ghana’s Group L schedule is as follows. First, Ghana vs Panama on Wednesday, June 17 in Toronto (kick-off 7:00 PM ET). This is the game Ghana must win. Then England vs Ghana on Tuesday, June 23 at Gillette Stadium (4:00 PM ET) — their hardest test. Finally, Croatia vs Ghana on Saturday, June 27 at Lincoln Financial Field (5:00 PM ET) — potentially a must-win if results have not gone to plan.
[...]
The route to the round of 16 runs through beating Panama and securing at least one point from the England and Croatia games. With the expanded 48-team format allowing third-placed finishers to progress, even a point or two could be enough. For the full guide to how the format works, check our World Cup 2026 new format and betting edges guide.
[...]
Ghana vs Panama (June 17, Toronto) is Ghana’s most winnable fixture. Panama reached the World Cup as relative underdogs and have limited depth beyond their first XI. Ghana should be capable of winning this match if they apply their quality from the first whistle. Ghana to win at around 1.85-2.00 represents value. Both teams to score — NO at around 1.60 also appeals, given Ghana’s defensive discipline under Queiroz and Panama’s limited attacking threat.
[...]
For England vs Ghana (June 23), England are strong favourites. However, Ghana have historically been competitive against major European nations and with the right performance could steal a draw. Ghana +1.5 on the Asian handicap is the angle here — likely priced around 1.50-1.60 and reducing risk significantly. Ghana to score at least one goal (YES) also has appeal at around 1.55.
[...]
Croatia vs Ghana (June 27) could be the pivotal final group game. With both teams potentially needing a result, this match may be the most intense of Ghana’s campaign. The draw is worth considering given the mutual need for a result. Match draw at around 3.00 could provide tournament-long value.
[...]
Ghana’s path to the round of 16 is possible but demanding. Beat Panama, take something from Croatia, and the expanded format’s third-place qualification route may be enough — even with a defeat to England in between. The Kudus absence is a genuine problem at a tournament level. However, Queiroz has built a resilient, experienced squad that knows how to defend and win collective battles.
[...]
Prediction: Ghana beat Panama, lose to England, and draw with Croatia. That leaves them on four points — enough to advance as a strong third-place side given the rest of the African group results. The Black Stars make it to the knockout rounds by the narrowest of margins. Stay across all the match previews and tips on our today’s free betting tips page throughout the tournament.

results.title: Ghana World Cup 2026: Squad, Key Players, Tactics and Predictions
highlights:
Otto Addo
[...]
Fifteen of the 26 players are making their World Cup debut. Queiroz described this as the most formidable challenge of his 43-year coaching career. The Panama opener on June 17 in Toronto is where everything starts and Ghana need to win it.
[...]
Ghana are drawn in Group L of the 2026 FIFA World Cup alongside England, Croatia and Panama. For all our World Cup 2026 predictions and analysis visit LeagueLane.
[...]
Queiroz uses a 4-2-3-1 with Partey and Elisha Owusu as the double pivot. The defensive structure is organised and compact. In attack, Semenyo and Inaki Williams operate from wide positions and Jordan Ayew plays as the central forward or drops into the number ten role depending on the game. Kamaldeen Sulemana and Fatawu Issahaku provide pace and directness from the bench. Queiroz has built his Ghana setup around defensive solidity first. He does not trust a high defensive line and he does not want Ghana to be exposed on the counter. Against England and Croatia that approach makes sense. Against Panama in the opener, it creates risk if Ghana are too passive in the first 30 minutes.

## LeagueLane Verdict
[...]
Ghana’s World Cup depends on the Panama opener. Win it and they arrive at the England game with confidence and a platform to push for second place. Lose it or draw and the pressure builds immediately for a new manager with limited time to prepare.
[...]
Queiroz is experienced enough to set up Ghana to be hard to beat in every game. Whether he has had enough time to make them difficult to beat and dangerous going forward simultaneously is the question that defines their tournament.
[...]
The Croatia game on June 27 in Philadelphia is the one that could define second place in Group L. If both teams arrive needing a result, Semenyo and Williams against Croatia’s ageing defensive line is the matchup Ghana will be building toward. Modric at 40 is a different defensive challenge to Modric at 33. Ghana can exploit the spaces Dalic’s system leaves behind.
[...]
For a betting angle, Semenyo to score in the tournament at odds that reflect his new-signing status at City is the play. He is in outstanding form, arrives motivated and faces Panama and Croatia in matches where he will have the space to express himself. Ghana to beat Panama and qualify for the knockout rounds as a third-place team is not an unreasonable ambition at the right price.

results.title: Ghana 2026 World Cup Preview
highlights:
Ghana heads to its fifth FIFA World Cup in 2026 following a dramatic managerial change, with Carlos Queiroz stepping in for Otto Addo after poor pre-tournament results. Despite missing AFCON, the Black Stars qualified comfortably and bring both attacking flair and experienced leadership to Group L, facing stern tests from England, Croatia, and Panama. Bookmakers consider Ghana long shots, but elite tournament expertise and explosive wide players mean they could surpass expectations—especially if they perform well against Panama and secure a top third-place slot.
